nodes.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Nine-phase implementation plan for adding Google Maps as an alternative provider — database storage for user API keys, a geocoding/routing provider abstraction layer, frontend settings UI, map component abstraction, API key encryption/validation, and fallback/error handling.

nodes.name: GOOGLE_PHOTOS_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Fifteen-phase plan for integrating Google Photos via OAuth and the Picker API, covering database schema changes, backend OAuth flow and photo linking, frontend browsing/selection UI, thumbnail caching strategy, security considerations, and a phased rollout.

nodes.name: OAUTH_SUPPORT_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Detailed plan for adding OpenID Connect (OAuth) login support (Authelia/Pocket ID) alongside existing password auth — a new OAuthIdentity model, backend OIDC service and routes, frontend login/callback/account-linking UI, Docker configuration, and a migration/rollback strategy.

nodes.name: PHOTO_MAP_VIEW_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for a map view of trip photos, covering a photo-location resolver hook, an optional bulk location-fetch backend endpoint, map UI updates with source differentiation, and a follow-up review section that resolves several data-shape issues found during design.

nodes.name: PWA_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Extremely detailed, multi-week Progressive Web App implementation plan covering service worker caching, an IndexedDB offline data layer, background sync and conflict resolution, offline authentication, offline trip preparation/downloads, iOS/Safari limitations, offline search, map tile pre-caching, storage management, and edge-case handling. The largest planning document in the project.

nodes.name: TEST_COVERAGE_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Phased plan to raise backend and frontend test coverage, prioritizing controllers and services first, followed by middleware/utils, route integration tests, frontend services/hooks, and components/pages, with a recommended execution order and target coverage goals.

nodes.name: UI_IMPROVEMENTS.md
nodes.summary: Ongoing UI improvement tracker with a dated progress log plus two detailed planned features (a compact trip list view and custom map tile styling), each broken into implementation phases with file-change lists and testing checklists.
